data.title: Price increase for Web & TV 250 from 1 June 2027
data.summary: Beispiel Kabel & Web GmbH raises the monthly base price of your "Web & TV 250" plan from €34.99 to €37.99 from 1 June 2027. You may cancel extraordinarily without cost.
data.explanation: Your cable/internet provider is raising your monthly price by €3.00 from 1 June 2027. Because the increase is to your disadvantage, you have a special right to cancel (außerordentliche Kündigung) under § 57 TKG, free of charge and without notice period, within three months after you received this letter. The app shows until when. The cancellation takes effect at the earliest when the increase starts. You can also stay in the contract and simply pay the new price. If you want to switch, compare other providers first.
